intro: Eight articles published between April 22 and May 17, 2026, cover path-traversal vulnerabilities, with six rated high and two critical. Key CVEs include CVE-2026-40050 (CVSS 9.8), CVE-2024-1708 (CVSS 8.4), CVE-2026-6282 (CVSS 8.1), CVE-2026-7819 (CVSS 8.1), and CVE-2021-47942 (CVSS 7.5). Affected sectors include government, consumer electronics, consumer IoT, enterprise, and financial services, with impact reported globally, particularly in North America and the United States.
